title: All tests must pass; failing tests never fixed by deletion
context: Quality control needed to ensure tests remain valuable.
decision: Every commit and every PR must pass all tests. A failing test is never fixed by skipping or deleting it. If test is genuinely wrong, explain why in commit message.
consequences: Prevents introduction of bugs that were once caught by deleted tests. Test suite remains aligned with current code. Running 1773 tests (632 Rust, 1141 JS/TS) on every PR.
